description: Augmenta Construction Platform deploys generative AI to enable contractors and engineers to design fully detailed, code-compliant, and constructible designs in hours rather than weeks or months.
BRUNT is reinventing the workwear category by crafting high-quality gear at the best possible price, starting from the ground up with work boots and apparel.
CalcTree is a flexible no-code web app that brings teams together by running in the cloud and integrating with the vast range of tools engineers and designers already know and love.
Canvas is a construction robotics company that delivers unrivaled quality, speed, and predictability by putting robots in the hands of skilled workers.

Constrafor is a procurement platform of cloud-based innovative solutions specifically designed to address the unique needs of the construction industry, enabling contractors to automate and integrate procurement workflows to lower administrative costs, improve invoice tracking, and reduce project risks with better reporting and forecasting.

EquipmentShare empowers contractors with complete visibility over their entire construction operations, whether they need to rent the right tool for the job, buy the latest machine or equipment part, or streamline operations with smart technology.

description: Exodigo is the new gold standard for non-intrusive discovery. Their subsurface mapping solutions combine advanced sensors, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to provide a clear picture of the underground for customers across transportation, utilities, construction, and more.

Hammr is on a mission to empower the builders that build the world. Subcontractors and self-performers rely on Hammr for time tracking, payroll, scheduling, benefits and compliance — in one centralized platform.​
Higharc is an intelligent homebuilding platform that simplifies, connects, and improves each step of the design, construction, and sales process.
HqO is the leading workplace experience platform designed to elevate the experiences of everyone who works in your building or office.
Kaya is building an AI-powered data and intelligence platform that provides unprecedented visibility, insight & coordination before, during & after a construction project.
Kojo is a materials management platform that helps companies increase efficiency, save on costs, and stay on schedule.

Measurabl is the world’s most widely adopted ESG (environmental, social, governance) solution for real estate. Customers use Measurabl to measure, manage, report, and act on ESG data on more than 15 billion square feet of commercial real estate across 92 countries.
nPlan’s AI forecasts project outcomes using historical data, making risk assurance easier, faster, and more reliable.
Nyfty.ai is an assistant that automates your job site using SMS, QR codes and Digital Passes, making it easy for people on your construction site to comply with basic processes.
OpenSpace provides next-generation reality capture software, powerful integrations, and the smartest analytics tools in the industry.
Outbuild makes construction projects easy with scheduling, lookaheads, and weekly plans finally all connected in one platform.

Placemakr is a flexible hospitality living platform, property manager, and real estate investor. Its tech-enabled operating platform allows the company to blur the line between hospitality and home, delivering the best experiences of both in a single building.

PLOT is a digital workspace to manage construction job sites. With PLOT’s Delivery Calendar, Logistics Map, and Structured Messenger, project teams can enhance communication and transparency in the field.

Procore is a top-rated construction management platform that makes it easier to minimize risk, protect profits, and take control of construction outcomes. After working with Suffolk Technologies, Procore’s stability has since allowed the company to exit the platform.
Pulley is the first dedicated platform for permitting that puts world-class software in the hands of local permitting professionals.

Rugged Robotics is a construction tech company whose first product tackles the challenge of field layout, and replaces slow, error-prone, manual layout with an autonomous vehicle that marks fully-coordinated A/E designs directly onto unfinished floors.

SewerAI is transforming the way utilities maintain & rehab their underground infrastructure. SewerAI automatically detects conditions in pipeline inspection data from CCTV crawler, digital side scanners, drones, GoPros, & jetter cameras.
Soil Connect is a leading software and construction services company that helps contractors, builders and haulers with their bulk material supply, demand and transportation needs.
The BuildClub App is an all-in-one delivery tool, uniting all your favorite building material suppliers in one platform.

TrustLayer is a collaborative risk management platform that helps reduce friction between businesses by automating the verification of insurance, licenses, and compliance documents from trade partners.

WINT detects and stops leaks at the source using Artificial Intelligence. Real-time monitoring identifies sources of leaks and waste preventing damage, reducing consumption and cutting the resulting carbon emissions.
